drug_food_interactions.reason: A governed food/component taxonomy has not been established; counts indicate whether a medication has any recorded assertion, not exhaustive ingredient-pair coverage.

evidence_appraisal.note: Source identity/integrity, source quality, and assertion evidence strength are distinct attributes.

interpretation: not_evaluated means no assessment is recorded; it does not mean no interaction, no contraindication, or safe use.
assertion_present_unreviewed means an assertion exists but has not passed independent clinical approval.
conflicting_evidence requires explicit resolution; the report does not choose one source automatically.
Dosage references are source summaries, not patient-specific prescriptions or dose calculations.
This report describes the shipped development dataset only; it is not an exhaustive drug-safety assessment.
